cuhkAdmission.introduction: Be an Urban Flâneur A flâneur is a person who saunters around town and appreciates things. According to cultural critic Walter Benjamin (1892–1940), an urban flâneur strolls casually through a city, enthralled by its dynamism and diversity. Our Urban Studies Programme (URSP) admits about 20 prospective flâneurs each year, grooming them to become urban leaders who meet urbanisation challenges with sustainable measures. The URSP Programme aims to help prospective flâneurs like you who care about our cities develop the capacity to read cities. We prepare you with concepts and skills to understand the urban realm to make it a better and more sustainable place for humankind. The Programme empowers you with the ability to develop ‘planet, place and people-friendly’ cities by learning about different theories and schools of thought; the rigorous application of skills and techniques for urban analysis; and contextual learning of best practices in sustainable development, governance, planning and design. Jointly organised by the School of Architecture and the Department of Geography and Resource Management, the URSP programme not only provides you with urban development theories, but also equips you with the capacity to appreciate the importance of aesthetics in directing urban development towards a sustainable and climate-proof future.

cuhkAdmission.careerProspects: Sustainable solutions often originate from detailed observations and place-based knowledge. In our highly specialised world, an integrated understanding of fragmented issues helps us develop sharp analytical and problem-solving skills. Urban issues are often highly complex problems, demanding creative, out-of-the-box solutions. The knowledge and skills acquired in this interdisciplinary programme allow you to be marketable in the public, private and civic sectors. Our URSP graduates excel in a range of professions and fields. Nearly 70% of the class of 2024 are pursuing further studies in Urban Planning, International City Planning, Spatial Planning, Environmental Science and Management and Urban Analytics, while rest of the graduates are working in commercial, media and public sectors. Some of our URSP graduates’ employers in the past years include: AECOM Albert So Surveyors Limited Beam Society Ltd CTA Consultant Limited Cushman and Wakefield DeSPACE (International) Limited Hong Kong Green Building Council Hong Kong Green Finance Association Hong Kong Jockey Club Jones Lang LaSalle IP, Inc. (JLL) Lai Sun Development Company Limited MTR Corporation Ove Arup & Partners RHL International Limited Shinewing TCC Global Townland Consultants Limited [Figures as of September 2024] CUHK URSP is accredited by the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS), the world’s leading professional body for qualifications and standards in land, property, infrastructure and construction. Our Programme is also the only undergraduate programme in Hong Kong that has obtained Spatial Planning accreditation by the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI), an international Chartered Institute for town planners. Our URSP graduates are eligible to apply for Chartered Membership in the two institutions upon completion of the specified requirements. Membership can enhance the skills and employability of graduates and facilitate their building of a global professional network. If you are interested in this programme, please review the application requirements and deadlines specific to the respective admission scheme to increase your chances of getting accepted. APPLY NOW
cuhkAdmission.craftYourPath: The URSP Programme engages our students with diverse learning pedagogical approaches, such as lectures, tutorials, field trips, site investigation and public forums. The Programme allows you to dig into the academic side while embracing practical experience to explore innovative solutions for urban issues. To better prepare for further studies, you may choose to declare your concentration in one of four specialised streams: Urban Planning and Design Urban Environment Urban Policy and Governance Smart Sustainable Cities The URSP Programme is dedicated to widening its students’ perspectives through immersive, international learning opportunities, such as interning in professional practices, ranging from urban planning to environmental protection, and overseas student exchange programmes. As a URSP student, you can apply for the ARUP Scholarship, comprising a scholarship of HK$15,000 and an eight-week, full-time, paid summer internship. The Programme also offers you an exclusive opportunity to study abroad in our student exchange partnering institution: the Department of Urban Studies and Planning at the University of Sheffield, one of the top RTPI-accredited planning schools in the UK.

curriculum.title: Curriculum
content: The Urban Studies Programme (URSP) is jointly organised by the School of Architecture and the Department of Geography and Resource Management.
Students explore urban theories, sustainable development, governance, planning, and design through lectures, tutorials, field trips, site investigations, and public forums.
Students may declare a concentration in one of four specialised streams:
- Urban Planning and Design
- Urban Environment
- Urban Policy and Governance
- Smart Sustainable Cities

The programme is accredited by the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS) and the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI) — the only undergraduate programme in Hong Kong with RTPI Spatial Planning accreditation.

International learning opportunities include an exclusive student exchange with the Department of Urban Studies and Planning at the University of Sheffield, a top RTPI-accredited planning school in the UK.
Students can apply for the ARUP Scholarship (HK$15,000 plus an 8-week paid summer internship).

career.title: Career Prospects
content: Graduates are prepared for careers in the public, private, and civic sectors, addressing complex urban challenges with creative, sustainable solutions.
Nearly 70% of the class of 2024 pursued further studies in Urban Planning, International City Planning, Spatial Planning, Environmental Science and Management, and Urban Analytics.
Past employers include: AECOM, MTR Corporation, Ove Arup & Partners, Jones Lang LaSalle, Cushman & Wakefield, Hong Kong Green Building Council, Hong Kong Jockey Club, and many more.
RICS and RTPI accreditation enhances global employability and allows graduates to apply for Chartered Membership.
Programme website: http://www.urbanstudies.cuhk.edu.hk

campus.title: Campus Life
content: CUHK's main campus is located in Shatin, offering a spacious and green environment with nine colleges, each providing residential, pastoral, and cultural experiences.
URSP students benefit from interdisciplinary learning across the School of Architecture and the Department of Geography and Resource Management.
International exposure includes overseas exchange programmes and internships with leading firms such as ARUP.
The programme also offers an exclusive exchange with the University of Sheffield's Department of Urban Studies and Planning.

tips.title: Ace Sir's Urban Studies Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Target Score: Best 5 ≥ 26**
Aim for a median of 26 or above. With LQ at 24.5, a score of 26 puts you in a strong position. Focus on your best 5 subjects — typically 4 core + 1 elective or 3 core + 2 electives.
- Prioritise English and electives; the median profile shows English 5 and two electives at 5* and 5.
**2. Band A Strategy: Put JS4838 as First Choice**
With only 23 Band A offers from 160 applicants, Band A placement is critical. Listing it as first choice signals strong interest.
- Prepare a compelling personal statement that links your experiences to urban sustainability.
**3. Excel in English and Electives**
The median profile shows English 5 and electives at 5* and 5. Strong performance here boosts your score significantly.
- Consider taking Geography, Economics, or Liberal Studies as electives — they align well with urban studies.
**4. Prepare for the Interview**
Interview is required. Expect questions on urban issues, your motivation, and analytical thinking.
- Practice discussing current urban challenges (e.g., climate resilience, housing, smart cities).
- Be ready to explain how URSP's interdisciplinary approach fits your goals.
**5. Demonstrate Interest in Urban Issues**
Show genuine passion through extracurriculars: volunteer work, urban-related projects, or reading.
- Follow CUHK URSP social media or attend their info sessions.
**6. Leverage RICS/RTPI Accreditation**
Mention in your application that URSP is the only Hong Kong undergraduate programme with RTPI Spatial Planning accreditation.
- This accreditation opens global career paths — highlight your interest in chartered membership.
**7. Consider the Streams**
Familiarise yourself with the four streams: Urban Planning and Design, Urban Environment, Urban Policy and Governance, Smart Sustainable Cities.
- Tailor your personal statement to one stream that matches your interests.
**8. Apply for the ARUP Scholarship**
The ARUP Scholarship offers HK$15,000 plus an 8-week paid summer internship. Mentioning this shows you've researched the programme.
- Prepare a strong application that demonstrates your commitment to sustainable urban development.
**9. Use Official Resources**
Visit the programme website (http://www.urbanstudies.cuhk.edu.hk) and CUHK Admissions page for updates.
- Check JUPAS page for any changes in requirements or deadlines.

curriculum.title: 課程結構
content: 城市研究課程由建築學院及地理與資源管理學系合辦。
學生透過講座、導修課、實地考察、場地調查及公開論壇，學習城市理論、可持續發展、管治、規劃與設計。
學生可選擇以下四個專修範疇之一：
- 城市規劃與設計
- 城市環境
- 城市政策與管治
- 智慧可持續城市
課程獲英國皇家特許測量師學會（RICS）及皇家城市規劃學會（RTPI）認可，是香港唯一獲得 RTPI 空間規劃認可的本科課程。
國際學習機會包括與英國雪菲爾大學城市研究與規劃學系的獨家交換計劃。
學生可申請奧雅納獎學金（HK$15,000 及 8 週有薪暑期實習）。

career.title: 就業前景
content: 畢業生可於公營、私營及公民社會領域發展，以創意及可持續方案應對複雜的城市挑戰。
2024 屆近 70% 畢業生繼續進修，修讀城市規劃、國際城市規劃、空間規劃、環境科學與管理及城市分析等碩士課程。
過往僱主包括：AECOM、港鐵公司、奧雅納、仲量聯行、高力國際、香港綠色建築議會、香港賽馬會等。
RICS 及 RTPI 認證提升全球就業能力，畢業生可申請特許會員資格。
課程網站：http://www.urbanstudies.cuhk.edu.hk

城市研究課程學生可受惠於建築學院及地理與資源管理學系的跨學科學習。
國際視野方面，學生可參與海外交換計劃及奧雅納等頂尖企業的實習。

tips.title: Ace Sir 的城市研究策略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: 以中位數 26 為目標。下四分位數為 24.5，取得 26 分將處於有利位置。專注最佳 5 科——通常為 4 核心 + 1 選修或 3 核心 + 2 選修。
- 優先提升英文及選修科成績；中位數成績顯示英文 5 級，選修科達 5* 及 5 級。
**2. Band A 策略：將 JS4838 置於首選**
Band A 僅 23 個學額，160 人申請，將課程置於首選顯示強烈興趣。
- 準備一份具說服力的個人陳述，連結你的經歷與城市可持續發展。
**3. 在英文及選修科取得佳績**
中位數成績顯示英文 5 級，選修科 5* 及 5 級。優異成績能大幅提升分數。
- 考慮選修地理、經濟或通識教育——這些科目與城市研究高度相關。
**4. 準備面試**
需要面試。預計問題圍繞城市議題、你的動機及分析能力。
- 練習討論當前城市挑戰（如氣候適應、房屋、智慧城市）。
- 準備解釋城市研究課程的跨學科方法如何配合你的目標。
**5. 展現對城市議題的興趣**
透過課外活動展現熱誠：義工服務、城市相關項目或閱讀。
- 關注中大城市研究社交媒體或參加其資訊講座。
**6. 善用 RICS/RTPI 認證**
在申請中提及城市研究課程是香港唯一獲得 RTPI 空間規劃認可的本科課程。
- 此認證開拓全球職業路徑——強調你對特許會員資格的興趣。
**7. 考慮專修範疇**
熟悉四個專修範疇：城市規劃與設計、城市環境、城市政策與管治、智慧可持續城市。
- 根據你的興趣，在個人陳述中針對其中一個範疇。
**8. 申請奧雅納獎學金**
奧雅納獎學金提供 HK$15,000 及 8 週有薪暑期實習。提及此獎學金顯示你已仔細研究課程。
- 準備一份有力的申請，展示你對可持續城市發展的承諾。
**9. 使用官方資源**
瀏覽課程網站（http://www.urbanstudies.cuhk.edu.hk）及中大入學網頁以獲取最新資訊。
- 查閱 JUPAS 頁面以了解要求或截止日期的任何變更。
